_what: Fuselage former stations for the F-86D Sabre (Comet kit R5), read off sheet 1's side view. Formers 1-10, nose to tail, confirmed sequential by the user.
method: A former is drawn as two lines ~1/16 in apart (its own thickness); the station is the pair's centre. Found by column darkness on the rotated side-view crop at 300 dpi, then numbered 1-10 nose to tail.
datum: The crop's left edge, just ahead of former 1 (the radar housing nose is forward of it). NOT a chosen aircraft datum: rebase before building if the nose tip should be zero.
checks: Exactly 10 lines exist: the gaps B-C, F-G and I-J were re-scanned at lower thresholds and are empty.
Formers 1 and 2 have separate leader arrows to two distinct lines at the nose, just behind the RADAR EQUIPMENT HOUSING.
All 10 numbered formers are traced in the PageWright project, so the counts agree.
Spacings are uneven (0.215 to 2.250 in), so frames_at, never frames_every.

formers.note: the USAF roundel and FUSELAGE MARKING RED annotations cross here, which made this line hard to read

do_not_confuse: F1-F6 on this plan are longerons and cockpit structure, NOT formers. F6 is the cockpit floor. The formers are the circled numbers.
